evidence.claim: The company reports that its Datapod System integrates infrastructure from APC by Schneider Electric, including the APC Hot Aisle Containment System and InRow Cooling solutions, to achieve a Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) of less than 1.3, according to a Datapod technical overview.
The company reports that its modular system design reduces energy consumption by up to 50% compared to traditional brick-and-mortar data centers, a capability recognized by an industry design award.
The company reports that its precision cooling units combine water cooling systems using chilled water with Direct Expansion (DX) systems to scale cooling according to data center needs.
The company reports that its system features water-side economizers combined with patented technology for the recuperation of server waste heat to reduce chiller system power consumption.
The company reports that its data centers utilize close-coupled cooling and an air containment system to maximize the efficiency of its heat exchangers.
The company reports that its system utilizes APC Inrow cooling systems and a Hot-Aisle-Containment system to ensure 100% of the exhaust heat from the racks is captured immediately.
The company reports that its Datapod System features chilled water cooling that enables a density of over 30 kW per rack.

American Power Conversion Corporation holds patent US7867070B2 for a data center cooling cabinet system featuring an airtight cabinet, an internal equipment cooling unit, and a modular remote chiller plant connected via insulated pipe-in-pipe hoses.

Power & Cooling Efficiency.assessed_on: We verified that the company's efficiency claims rest primarily on pre-engineered factory design thresholds and integrated partner infrastructure. Based on primary research, the company's operational PUE metrics can be estimated as superior, indicating optimal cooling efficiency, based on its partnership with APC by Schneider Electric utilizing their highly energy-efficient Hot Aisle Containment System and InRow Cooling solutions.

estimates.basis: its partnership with APC by Schneider Electric utilizing their highly energy-efficient Hot Aisle Containment System and InRow Cooling solutions
